dataset: International football results from 1872 (men's senior full internationals)

notes: Files are stored byte-for-byte as downloaded. To refresh, follow docs/ml/ML_PIPELINE_V3.md (replace the files, update this record, re-run the training workflow); a refresh changes the corpus fingerprint recorded in every model manifest.
